scope: Real FR records exported and read by freshly installed tool outside original checkout; same host, no research quality or comparative effort claim.

steps.stdout:
starter-kit: initializing in <temporary>/project
  git init (the pre-commit honesty gate needs a repo; KIT_NO_GIT=1 to skip)
  hook installed live in .git/hooks/pre-commit (tracked source of truth: .githooks/pre-commit)
  created docs/evidence/NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE.md
  no beads CLI found; using the JSONL fallback (.beads/issues.jsonl is the database).
  seeded 28 checklist beads in .beads/issues.jsonl

Done. The one rule: a step you can satisfy by believing you did it is not a step.

Next steps:
  1. Fill docs/planning/packet.md (working copy of templates/planning-packet.md).
     templates/ holds READ-ONLY reference copies — always edit the installed
     working copy (docs/planning/packet.md, registries/claims.tsv), never the template.
  2. Run ./scripts/check-readiness.sh — it reports NOT READY until every section is filled.
     Each packet section's guidance names the vocabulary the checker requires.
  3. Build your first proofs, then register every public claim in registries/claims.tsv
     (set enforce=yes once the proof exists; readme_pattern must match README prose exactly).
  4. Write the README LAST: the claim gate blocks any non-empty README until at least
     one claim is enforced with a real proof (CHECKLIST.md B6).
  5. Record falsified hypotheses in docs/evidence/NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE.md as you work.
  6. Review AGENTS.md (the 12 forbidden patterns) and docs/definition-of-done.md —
     both installed for you; tailor them but keep the patterns verbatim.
  7. Work Phase A of docs/CHECKLIST.md; close the seeded beads with cited evidence.
     (JSONL fallback: set "status":"closed", "closed_at":"<UTC>",
      "close_reason":"<evidence citation>" on the bead's line in .beads/issues.jsonl.)
  8. Make your first commit — the pre-commit hook self-tests with a canary false
     claim before it checks anything real.
  9. When Phase A is green, sign the packet and start Phase B.
  10. Read docs/REFERENCES.md to see where every mechanism came from.
  Optional recurring research: docs/DECISIONS.md explains the Python 3.9+
  review queue. No record is required by the shell gates.

CI backstop: .github/workflows/kit-gates.yml re-runs the readiness, ledger and
claim-discipline gates on every push — that is the gate 'git commit
--no-verify' cannot bypass. Fill in the commented toolchain steps per
your language (fmt/lint/test/build).

post_review.scope: After fresh test receipt and separate code review, resolved kit decision omitted; synthetic source change queues it again. No speedup claim.
